verification_notes: All market size figures come from third-party market research firms with varying methodologies. The $15B AI-BI market size (2026) comes from Intel Market Research; the conservative $68.42B-by-2034 figure from HTF MI may use a broader market definition. Product launch dates for Tableau Pulse (Feb 2024), ThoughtSpot Spotter (Nov 2024), and Power BI Copilot default enablement (Sep 2025) are corroborated by vendor blogs and press releases. Sigma Computing 2026 Series E details [marked unverified in trend data] could not be confirmed from a primary source. Market share figures (Power BI ~22%, Tableau ~18%) come from 6sense deployment data via third-party analysis and vary by methodology.
